verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payments platform, so user-configured background automations are a fair question for it. The evidence shows no first-party automation builder or autonomous agent capability. The closest items are webhooks (a developer building block), a Zapier guide (a third-party user-side workaround), and a merchant deposit-frequency setting (an adjacent control). None of these count as the product's own automation feature for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
